muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿وقيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «قيل» is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿من﴾: an interrogative in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿راق﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ that was elided because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. The clause that is the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وظن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ظن» is a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿أنه﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿الفراق﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «أن», nominative (marfūʿ); «أن» and what falls within its scope are in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the two objects of ﴿ظن﴾.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿والتفت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «التفت» is a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine.
﴿الساق﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿بالساق﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿التفت﴾.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿إلى ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿يومئذ﴾: an adverb (ẓarf), attached to the omitted khabar to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; «إذٍ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for four clauses, the implied form being: "on the day when [the soul] reaches the collarbones, and it is said 'Who is a healer?', and he is certain that it is the parting, and shank is wrapped with shank".
﴿المساق﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿صدق﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he), i.e. man.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿صلى﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause is conjoined to His saying: ﴿أيحسب الإنسان أن لن نجمع عظامه﴾, and it was said: conjoined to the clause ﴿يسأل أيّان يوم القيامة﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لكن» is lightened (mukhaffafa) and inoperative (muhmala).
﴿كذب﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿وتولى﴾: the wāw is a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently something has dropped out, i.e. "the wāw is a conjunction, and «تولى» is a past verb"]; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "huwa" (he), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay.
﴿ذهب﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿إلى أهله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ذهب﴾.
﴿يتمطى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause «يتمطى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the fāʿil of ﴿ذهب﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿أولى﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma.
﴿لك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿فأولى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أولى» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first «أولى».

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay.
﴿أولى﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma.
﴿لك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿فأولى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أولى» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first «أولى»,
and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿الإنسان﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿أن﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿يترك﴾: an imperfect verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), accusative (manṣūb); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿سدى﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «يترك».

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation and disapproval (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī al-inkārī), and «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], and jussive.
﴿يك﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn that was elided for lightening; the noun of «يك» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he), i.e. man.
﴿نطفة﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿من مني﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective).
﴿يمنى﴾: an imperfect verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), nominative (marfūʿ); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, its implied form being "huwa" (it), referring back to «المني»; the clause ﴿يمنى﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿مني﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay.
﴿كان﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿علقة﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿فخلق﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for sequence and immediate succession, and «خلق» is a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa" (He), i.e. Allah.
﴿فسوى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for sequence and immediate succession, and «سوى» is a past verb; the fāʿil is "huwa" (He), i.e. Allah; and the clause is conjoined to what came before.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿فجعل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for sequence and immediate succession, and «جعل» is a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa" (He), i.e. Allah; and the clause is conjoined to what came before.
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الزوجين﴾: the first object of ﴿جعل﴾.
﴿الذكر﴾: badal (substitute), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿والأنثى﴾: conjoined to «الذكر».

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿أليس﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and affirmation (al-istifhām al-inkārī al-taqrīrī), and «ليس» is an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb.
﴿ذلك﴾: the noun of «ليس».
﴿بقادر﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and «قادر» is genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of «ليس».
﴿على﴾: a preposition.
﴿أن﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿يحيي﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa" (He); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يحيي﴾ is a noun in the genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قادر﴾.
﴿الموتى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿لا﴾: negating, or connective (ṣila) to strengthen the oath.
﴿أقسم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); and the fāʿil (agent), its implied form being: "I" (أنا).
﴿بيوم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقسم﴾; and يوم is muḍāf.
﴿القيامة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating, or connective (ṣila) to strengthen the oath.
﴿أقسم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "I" (أنا).
﴿بالنفس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقسم﴾.
﴿اللوامة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿النفس﴾; and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause; and the response to the oath is omitted, i.e.: "you will surely be resurrected", indicated by what comes after it.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿أيحسب﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and rebuke (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī), and يحسب is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿الإنسان﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative.
﴿ألن﴾: أن is lightened from the heavy (form) (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), its ism being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); and لن is a particle of negation, subjunctive and future.
﴿نجمع﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); and the clause ﴿لن نجمع عظامه﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أن.
﴿عظامه﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lightened أن with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of يحسب; and the interrogative clause ﴿أيحسب...﴾ is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿بلى﴾: a particle of answer, to cancel the negation in ﴿لن نجمع عظامه﴾, i.e.: "yes indeed, We will gather them".
﴿قادرين﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of the implied verb indicated by the particle of answer, i.e.: "yes indeed, We will gather them, being able".
﴿على﴾: a preposition.
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle.
﴿نسوي﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: "we" (نحن); the maṣdar-forming أن with what falls within its scope is construed as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قادرين﴾.
﴿بنانه﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿بل﴾: for transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī).
﴿يريد﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿الإنسان﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative.
﴿ليفجر﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and يفجر: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal lām; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being ﴿هو﴾, referring to الإنسان; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb is genitive by the causal lām; the lām with its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يريد﴾; and the object of يريد is omitted, indicated by the cause given in the saying of the Exalted ﴿ليفجر أمامه﴾, its implied form being: "man wants his lusts and his sins". Or the lām in ﴿ليفجر﴾ is connective (ṣila), and يفجر is an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يفجر﴾ is the object of يريد, its implied form being: "man wants wickedness".
﴿أمامه﴾: أمام is an adverb, accusative; it is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿يريد...﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause ﴿أيحسب﴾, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يسأل﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿أيان﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time; it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿يوم﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and it is muḍāf.
﴿القيامة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). And the clause is in the place of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يريد or from the fāʿil of يفجر; or it is resumptive, expressing wonder at their state in asking about the time of the Day of Resurrection — it being a question of mockery, since they believe it impossible that it will happen — and so has no grammatical position; or it is a badal (substitute) of the clause ﴿يريد﴾, and so has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the response, which is: يقول.
﴿برق﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿البصر﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause ﴿برق البصر﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the adverb being put in annexation to it; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وخسف﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿القمر﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وجمع﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿الشمس﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿والقمر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and القمر is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الشمس, nominative.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿يقول﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿الإنسان﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative; and the clause يقول الإنسان has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقول﴾; and إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for a clause, the implied form being: "man will say on the day when the sight is dazzled, and the moon is eclipsed, and the sun and the moon are joined together".
﴿أين﴾: أين is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place; the adverb is attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿المفر﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation (lā al-nāfiya li-l-jins).
﴿وزر﴾: the ism (noun) of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: "existing, available to them".

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿إلى ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); رب is muḍāf, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb of time, attached to the omitted khabar to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; and إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "on the day when the sight is dazzled … etc."
﴿المستقر﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ينبأ﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿الإنسان﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ). And the clause ﴿ينبأ الإنسان﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينبأ﴾; and إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "on the day when the sight is dazzled … etc."
﴿بما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قدم﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو). And the clause ﴿قَدَّم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأخر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو). And the clause ﴿أخر﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause ﴿قدم﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿بل﴾: a conjunction and (particle of) transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī).
﴿الإنسان﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿على نفسه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بصيرة﴾; نفس is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿بصيرة﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), (the clause being a ḥāl) from the agent concealed in ﴿بصيرة﴾; and لو is conditional.
﴿ألقى﴾: a past verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿معاذيره﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: "they would not be acceptable, and would not be accepted".

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿لا﴾: prohibitive (nāhiya).
﴿تحرك﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تحرك﴾.
﴿لسانك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لسان is muḍāf, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لتعجل﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl), and تعجل is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām; and the lām with its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تحرك﴾.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تعجل﴾; and the pronoun in ﴿به﴾ refers to the Qur'an.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿جمعه﴾: the postponed ism (noun) of inna.
﴿وقرآنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and قرآنه is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جمعه; قرآن is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb for future time.
﴿قرأناه﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the ﴿نا﴾ of the agents; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause قرأناه is in the position of the genitive by the adverb being put in annexation to it.
﴿فاتبع﴾: the fāʾ binds the response of ﴿إذا﴾, and اتبع is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).
﴿قرآنه﴾: قرآن is mafʿūl bihi; it is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī).
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿بيانه﴾: بيان is the postponed ism (noun) of inna; it is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿بل﴾: a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī).
﴿تحبون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿العاجلة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وتذرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause.
﴿الآخرة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وجوه﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ناضرة﴾; and إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "on the day when the Resurrection takes place".
﴿ناضرة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وجوه﴾, or a first khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿إلى ربها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ناظرة﴾.
﴿ناظرة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of وجوه.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿ووجوه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and وجوه is mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿باسرة﴾; and إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "on the day when the Resurrection takes place".
﴿باسرة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وجوه﴾, or a first khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿تظن﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "they" (هي); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of وجوه.
﴿أن﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿يفعل﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), and it is built for an unnamed agent (passive); and أن with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of ﴿تظن﴾.
﴿بها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يفعل﴾.
﴿فاقرة﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb for future time.
﴿بلغت﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "it" (هي); and the clause بلغت is in the position of the genitive by the adverb being put in annexation to it.
﴿التراقي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
